cd /opt/weather-tg; python3 - <<EOF
import weather_tg_channel as ch, time, math
env=ch.load_env(); keys=[k for k in env.get("WU_KEYS","").split(",") if k]
c0=None
for sid,name in ch.STATIONS:
    raw=ch.fetch_station(sid,keys,int(time.time()//600)); time.sleep(0.3)
    if not raw: print(sid,"no data"); continue
    o=raw[-1]; lat=o.get("lat"); lon=o.get("lon")
    if lat is None: lat=(o.get("metric") or {}).get("lat")
    print(sid,name,lat,lon,o.get("neighborhood"),o.get("country"))
EOF
